# CPU environment: everything `pytest` and the no-GPU CLI subcommands
# (`smoke`, `measure`, `report`) need, and nothing else.
#
# GPU model stacks are deliberately NOT here. RFdiffusion, LigandMPNN and
# Boltz-2 pin incompatible torch/CUDA builds, so each is installed separately
# on the cluster and reached through the paths in config/pipeline.yaml.
#
# Resolved and tested on Python 3.12.10.

PyYAML==6.0.3
pydantic==2.12.5
pytest==9.2.0
